svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Architecture
svg.desc: Bands come from layerKind over all 40 layers, so no layer is grouped to fit the drawing and no band exists that the layer pattern does not produce. The handoff is one residual stream in one direction; nothing here asserts a cross-attention, a shared KV cache or a second encoder network. DSpark parameters are unpublished and excluded from every total on this page. Phase depths describe the reported CED scheme; the pinned reference forward still visits all backbone layers.
